product_name: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion 5G (Pantone Blue Surf, 8GB RAM, 256GB Storage) | Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 Processor | 50MP Sony LYTIA Camera | 6.78" 144Hz AMOLED Display | 7000mAh Battery | 68W Fast Charging
description: Powerful Snapdragon Performance: Powered by Qualcomm Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 processor for smooth multitasking, gaming, and 5G connectivity. Pro-Grade Camera System: 50MP Sony LYTIA 710 main camera with OIS + 13MP ultra-wide camera and 32MP front camera for sharp photos and videos. Immersive 144Hz AMOLED Display: 6.78-inch 1.5K quad-curved AMOLED display with HDR10+ and ultra-smooth 144Hz refresh rate. Massive 7000mAh Battery: Long-lasting silicon-carbon battery with 68W fast charging for extended usage. Premium & Durable Design: Pantone Blue Surf finish with Gorilla Glass 7i protection, IP68/IP69 water resistance, and stereo speakers with Dolby Atmos. Premium Pantone Blue Surf Design – Fabric-style textured back finish with slim curved design. Dolby Atmos Stereo Speakers – Dual stereo speakers provide immersive sound for movies and gaming.
